text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The glorious powerhouses,
known to the world as the 'Golden Generation.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And now, those girls have gathered together in the Trainer's office. Their purpose is—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Let's start prepping the pot!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Oooh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Yes, today is a hot pot party... and for that, everyone brought their own ingredients."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Man, I'm so happy!
To think we can all gather like this at the end of the year and share a hot pot...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "H-Huh? Tsuru-chan, are you crying!?"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yeah!! 'Cause I was cutting green onions!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, hey, King.
Do you know how to peel vegetables?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, of course I do!
Umm, first, how to hold a knife is...-!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, guess I won't be slacking off today.
Too bad. ...Here, pass that over to me for a sec~

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The key to cooking is color.
Let's add some flair to the pot♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I see~... Wha!?
You put dandelions in it?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Waaah...! Veggies, meat, seafood...!
Thanks to everyone, we have a super loaded hot pot!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That extra-large horsehair crab sitting right on top really feels like the main star!
Mmm, looks so delicious!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Well then... time to, eat!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...In that instant, the mood in the room shifted.
Everyone's eyes gleamed with wild, feral intensity!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO!! The horsehair crab, and the spotlight,
are all miiiine!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, everyone's swarming the main ingredients after all...!
There's no opening for me to slip in...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for your hard work, everyone~
Now then, while they're busy, I'll just...
Ooh, this scallop looks perfectly cooked.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Toryaaaa! Condor Aerial Assault!
The horsehair crab is MINE, deee-su!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: —Wh-What?! Where is the horsehair crab, desu ka?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My, my, El, you certainly have room to show off flashy moves~.
Your guard was wide open,
so I went ahead and took it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Not yet! This match isn't over yet~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That was delicious!
Thank you for the meal!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...What's wrong, Spe-chan?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You know... I was just thinking this hot pot
kind of felt like a race with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It turned into such a great hot pot because everyone was here.
Making it together was fun, and competing over the food was fun too...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: During races too... running alongside everyone. Competing with all my might—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I don't want to lose, but...
sometimes we support each other."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It just made me realize all over again...
that having everyone around is what made it so fun.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. It somehow feels
like a total wrap-up.
I'm getting quite sentimental.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
However, it is far too early
to wrap up the race.
The real battle is only just beginning.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah. I know.
It's just—in the end, I'm gonna be the one who wins!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe, just like winning
first prize with today's hot pot!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As Special Week says that, an enormous horsehair crab shell sits majestically on her plate.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Looking back on their past and pledging
toward their future, the 'Golden Generation'
sets off running toward tomorrow once more.”

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I'm not gonna let you win that easily.
I didn't make today's main race easy for you either, did I?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Looks like we ended up
sharing it among everyone... Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Well, let's call it a draw for today!
Shall we make some rice porridge to finish up?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Looking back on their past and pledging
toward their future, the 'Golden Generation'
sets off running toward tomorrow once more.”

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
“Still... I let victory slip away this time...
*Sigh*...”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Wondering what happened, I look over and see no horsehair crab shells on her plate. It seems she ended up missing out on the main ingredient.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Looking back on their past and pledging
toward their future, the 'Golden Generation'
sets off running toward tomorrow once more.”
